name: Light and patchy
notes: Wind model #10: 6-9 kn, oscillation +/-10 deg over 150-180 s, no persistent trend; sparse, strong (+35 %) puffs and many lulls.
Units: knots, degrees, seconds, metres; gains, losses, shares, coverage and drift as fractions.

Version 2 (schema 2, #75) is version 1 plus the keyed wind's wobble: wobbleDegrees is the peak of the smaller, faster wobble (#10) each 30 s window's key draws on top of the oscillation, vanishing at the window's knots. Strength is fixed for the race (#10), so there is no strength-channel tuning.

Placeholders (JSON Pointers above) await tuning: the 1 deg wobble (#10 says only smaller and faster; about 1/10 of the amplitude keeps the peak shift within 1.2 x the amplitude), and the puff columns, set from #10's words (sparse, strong, many lulls) and its shared ranges (60-150 m, puffs +20-35 %, lulls -15-25 %, fan up to 8 deg, drift 0.3-0.5 x wind).
